title: Мнимая амнезия, свадьба и спасение ресторана  (Fake Amnesia, the Wedding, and Saving the Restaurant)

scenes.title: The Horseman and Falling off the Horse
scenes.summary: Max proposes to Vika from a white horse, falls off, and pretends in the hospital that he only remembers the day they first met.

scenes.title: Diagnosis: Traumatic Amnesia
scenes.summary: Max pretends not to recognize Kostya, and the doctor tells Vika and Kostya that Max has traumatic amnesia.

scenes.title: The Crisis Manager and the Lost Earring
scenes.summary: Andrey introduces crisis manager Sergey Vladimirovich to Chef Barinov, who notices Andrey's wife is missing an earring.

scenes.title: Someone Else's Scan and Smoke Coupons
scenes.summary: Max thanks the doctor for using a motorcyclist's scan to fool Vika, while Sergey introduces smoke-break coupons in the kitchen.

scenes.title: The Face of the Restaurant, Not Its Stomach
scenes.summary: Sergey cuts Nagiyev's discount for eating too much, prompting a humiliated Nagiyev to demand to buy his restaurant back.

scenes.title: Where Should the Patient Go?
scenes.summary: As Max leaves the hospital, the bribed doctor convinces everyone that Max needs quiet care at Vika's apartment.

scenes.title: Moving in with Vika and Visiting Sergey
scenes.summary: Vika agrees to let Max stay at her apartment until the wedding, while Chef Barinov visits Sergey's hotel room.

scenes.title: Messages on the Phone
scenes.summary: Vika claims she and Max were only work friends until Max reads her passionate and angry text messages from his phone.

scenes.title: I Didn't Hit My Head
scenes.summary: Vika admits she loved Max until he betrayed her, and rejects his offer to start over because she still remembers everything.

scenes.title: The Chef's Quail and the Restroom Question
scenes.summary: Vika tends to Max at home, while in the kitchen Chef Barinov learns Sergey cut his signature quail dish from the menu.

scenes.title: The Find in the Hotel Room
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov confronts Sergey with Olya's missing earring that he found on the floor of Sergey's hotel room.

scenes.title: The Hidden Camera and the Chef's Victory
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov plays the hidden-camera recording of Sergey with Andrey's wife, forcing the crisis manager to resign.

scenes.title: The Wedding Dance with Vika
scenes.summary: Max visits Claude Monet during the wedding dance rehearsal, dances with Vika, and tells her she is very beautiful.

scenes.title: The Lie Exposed and a Broken Leg
scenes.summary: Max slips up by remembering what happened last week, exposing his fake amnesia to Vika and Kostya, who breaks his foot in anger.

scenes.title: The Bride's Tears
scenes.summary: At the wedding ceremony, Nastya bursts into tears over the missing bouquet, Kostya's leg cast, and having no best man.

scenes.title: A Speedy Marriage and a Toast to the Newlyweds
scenes.summary: Nastya goes into labor during the ceremony, so she and Kostya rush through their vows before heading to the hospital.

scenes.title: The Closing of Claude Monet
scenes.summary: Andrey Mikhailovich announces that the board is closing Claude Monet and turning it into a beer sports bar.

scenes.title: Fire in the Kitchen and Rodion's Gift
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov sets the kitchen on fire to save its honor just as Nagiyev arrives announcing he bought Claude Monet back with Rodion's help.

scenes.title: Katya's Advice
scenes.summary: The chefs extinguish the kitchen fire, and Katya advises Vika not to give up on Max while he still loves her.

scenes.title: Vika's Proposal and the Birth of a Son
scenes.summary: Vika forgives Max and asks him to marry her, and at the hospital Kostya and Nastya welcome their newborn son with Max.
